intents.statement: When the prose is extracted again, an intent with the same statement keeps its review verdict (approved, amended or rejected).
intents.quote: an intent with the same statement keeps its verdict and its approvals

intents.statement: When the prose is extracted again, an intent with the same statement keeps its approvals.
intents.quote: an intent with the same statement keeps its verdict and its approvals

intents.statement: If a reviewer amended an intent and the AI proposes its original reading again for the same quote, the amendment is applied again.
intents.quote: If a reviewer amended an intent and the AI proposes its original reading again for the same words, the amendment is applied again

intents.statement: Every other re-extracted intent comes back as proposed.
intents.quote: Everything else comes back as proposed

intents.statement: A decision asked again with the same question keeps its answer.
intents.quote: A decision asked again with the same question keeps its answer

decisions.question: When an amendment is applied again, do the approvals of the amended wording come back too?

options.label: Yes, keep them
options.consequence: The reviewed wording is unchanged, so nobody has to approve it again.

options.label: No, approve again
options.consequence: Every edit near an amended intent sends it back to the reviewers.

decisions.question: Does "the same statement" (or question) ignore letter case and spacing?

options.label: Ignore case and spacing
options.consequence: Re-wrapping a line or changing capitalization does not reopen the review.

options.label: Exact text only
options.consequence: Any cosmetic change in the AI's wording reopens the review of that intent.

notPromised: That decisions raised by the consistency check, and the intents created from their answers, survive a new extraction.
That an intent keeps its id (I1, I2...) when intents are added or removed above it.
